scenarios.name: negative-power-deals-damage-as-positive
scenarios.why: Loot is -2/4. Normally a creature with power 0 or less assigns no combat damage (CR 510.1a), but his power is negative, so he assigns combat damage as though it were 2: unblocked, the opponent goes to 18. His power is still -2 afterwards.

scenarios.name: threshold-sacrifice-creature-hits-harder
scenarios.why: With seven cards in his controller's graveyard, sacrificing another creature (Savannah Lions) gives Loot -2/-0 until end of turn: -4/4. Attacking unblocked he assigns 4 combat damage as though his power were positive.

scenarios.name: threshold-sacrifice-planeswalker
scenarios.why: The cost accepts a planeswalker too: with threshold, sacrificing Ajani Goldmane makes Loot -4/4 and Ajani goes to its owner's graveyard.

scenarios.name: below-threshold-or-nothing-else-not-offered
scenarios.why: With only six cards in the graveyard the ability is not offered even though Savannah Lions could be sacrificed; and with seven cards but no OTHER creature or planeswalker (Loot cannot sacrifice himself) it is not offered either.

scenarios.name: blocked-deals-damage-to-blocker
scenarios.why: Blocked by Grizzly Bears, Loot (-2/4) assigns 2 combat damage to the blocker as though his power were positive: the Bears die; Loot takes 2 and survives.
